description: Find bus stops near a location. Returns stops within a radius, each with ID, name, direction, served routes, and wheelchair boarding status. Use stopId values from results to fetch real-time arrivals with onebusaway_get_arrivals. Optionally filter by stop code (the number printed on the stop sign, e.g. "75403").

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, in [-90, 90].

lon.description: Longitude of the search center, in [-180, 180].

query.description: Optional stop code filter (the number printed on the stop sign, e.g. "75403"). When provided, returns only stops matching this code within the radius.

radius.description: Search radius in meters. Must be positive; capped at 1600m, beyond which results degrade. Defaults to 300m.

name: onebusaway_find_stops

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if more stops exist beyond the returned set; narrow the radius to see all.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty or truncated — e.g. how to narrow the radius or verify the stop code.

query.description: Stop code filter applied to the search, if any.

items.description: A transit stop with location and route information.

code.description: The stop code printed on the sign.

direction.description: Compass direction of travel at this stop (e.g. "NW").

id.description: Agency-prefixed stop ID (e.g. "1_75403"). Use with onebusaway_get_arrivals.

routeIds.description: IDs of routes that serve this stop.

title: Find Stops Near Location
